ngaap.guidance: 2020 guidance updated 30-Oct-2020: Revenue ~$18.4 billion, up organically ~4.0% on a pro forma basis (narrowed to mid-point of previous range of $18.2 - $18.6 billion, up 3% - 5%). GAAP net income margin of ~7.4% (increased from previous guidance of 7.1%+). Adjusted EBIT margin of ~17.75% (increased from previous guidance of 17.5%+). GAAP EPS of ~$6.44 (increased from previous guidance of $6.03 - $6.43). Non-GAAP EPS of ~$11.55 (increased to upper end of previous guidance of $11.15 - $11.55). Operating cash flow and adjusted free cash flow of $2.82 - $2.87 billion and $2.65 - $2.70 billion, respectively (expanded to upper end of previous ranges of $2.8 - $2.9 billion and $2.6 - $2.7 billion). ~$2.2 billion in share repurchases, inclusive of proceeds from divestitures announced year-to-date (increased from previous guidance of ~$1.7 billion). Guidance tables: revenue ~$18,400; net income ~$1,360; discontinued operations ~2; net interest expense ~255; income taxes ~279; L3Harris Merger integration costs ~140; restructuring charges and other items ~29; amortization of acquisition-related intangibles ~703; inventory step-up ~31; business divestiture-related losses ~62; other divestiture-related expenses ~11; impairment ~394; total adjustments ~1,906; adjusted EBIT ~$3,266 (~17.75%). EPS bridge: GAAP ~$6.44; integration ~0.65; restructuring ~0.14; amortization ~3.25; step-up ~0.14; divestiture losses ~0.29; other divestiture expenses ~0.05; impairment ~1.82; NCI ~(0.15); total pre-tax ~6.19; taxes ~(1.08); after-tax ~5.11; non-GAAP ~$11.55. Cash flow: operating cash flow $2,819 to $2,869; net additions of PP&E ~(350); free cash flow $2,469 to $2,519; cash used for integration ~181; adjusted FCF $2,650 to $2,700.
ngaap.notes: Non-GAAP EPS = income from continuing operations per diluted share attributable to common shareholders, excluding L3Harris Merger integration costs, amortization of acquisition-related intangibles (ALL acquired intangibles, incl. Exelis), fair-value inventory step-up, divestiture expenses/losses, restructuring and other items, impairment of goodwill and other assets / COVID-19 charges, net of the noncontrolling-interest portion and of income taxes. Adjusted EBIT = net income + discontinued operations + net interest expense + income taxes + the same pre-tax items (i.e. it INCLUDES non-operating income / non-service FAS pension income). Adjusted free cash flow = operating cash flow - net additions of PP&E + cash used for L3Harris Merger integration (and transaction) costs. FCF bridge values are the QUARTER column (three quarters: operating cash flow 2,092, capex (194), FCF 1,898, integration cash 146, adjusted FCF 2,044). Dollar tax effect not published in this release; the Q3-21 release later shows the Q3-20 adjustments as: total EBIT adjustments 218 (215 unallocated items + 3 Aviation Systems), income-tax effect (38), non-GAAP income from continuing operations 611. The release also gives revenue excluding the Commercial Aviation Solutions and Public Safety sectors: 4,284 vs 3,990 (+7.4%).

notes: is.op_income is COMPUTED (revenue - cost of sales - ESA - other operating lines): neither the release nor the 10-Q prints an operating income line (the statement goes straight to income before income taxes); it equals the sum of segment operating income and the reconciling lines. Unlabeled totals in lines_raw carry bracketed labels; EPS lines are prefixed 'Basic:' / 'Diluted:'. bs.lines_raw = the release's condensed balance sheet (unclassified, no subtotals; '[Total ...]' labels are unlabeled totals) followed by the extra lines of the 10-Q classified balance sheet prefixed '10-Q: '. tca / tcl / deferred_tax_l / equity_parent / nci / shares_out are from the 10-Q; bs.tl is COMPUTED = total current liabilities + total non-current liabilities (the 10-Q prints no total-liabilities line). Cash flow is year to date (three quarters, 9 months). Year-to-date prior-year comparisons in the release still use pro forma figures (not recorded). All schema self-checks pass.
